answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 68 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 68 epochs of grading, and every knoll settlement recomputes the ripple schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
